Integrated Resources, Inc., is led by a seasoned team with combined decades in the industry. We deliver strategic workforce solutions that help you manage your talent and business more efficiently and effectively. Since launching in 1996, IRI has attracted, assembled and retained key employees who are experts in their fields. This has helped us expand into new sectors and steadily grow.

We’ve stayed true to our focus of finding qualified and experienced professionals in our specialty areas. Our partner-employers know that they can rely on us to find the right match between their needs and the abilities of our top-tier candidates. By continually exceeding their expectations, we have built successful ongoing partnerships that help us stay true to our commitments of performance and integrity.  

Our team works hard to deliver a tailored approach for each and every client, critical in matching the right employers with the right candidates. We forge partnerships that are meant for the long term and align skills and cultures. At IRI, we know that our success is directly tied to our clients’ success.  

## Job Description

Job Detail:

Position: Data Analyst

Location: Philadelphia

Duration: 6 month

 Job Description:

• Play a key role in the assessment of one of our client’s major workstreams which is from healthcare enrollment through claims ready processing – to see where there are points of failure, data discrepancies and make recommendations on how they can improve their processes. 

• Perform a data analysis of this claims process; and identify, address and escalate any data discrepancies/issues as a result of the analysis.

• Analyze and communicate the issues and risks as they relate to the pilot project.

• Develop and maintain a customer-focused relationship with business stakeholders by exhibiting a high level of collaboration, timely communication and responsiveness. 

• Clearly set expectations for each key project milestone and then manage the business stakeholders and the project team to those expectations.

  

Required skills:

• Minimum of 5 years of experience performing data analysis; including identifying, addressing and escalating any data discrepancies/issues as a result of an analysis.

• Prior experience analyzing healthcare insurance claims data is a big plus; including the ability to create reports (using Excel and MS Access) to provide information that will help team understand any data discrepancies and potential data issues that require remediation.

• Must have prior consulting experience in a large corporate environment.

• Must be a self-starter, proactive, self-directed and can work efficiently with limited guidance.

• Must possess very strong organizational, task management and prioritization skills.

• Comprehensive understanding and some practical exposure to using relational databases.

• Experience with reporting tools, data warehouses, MS-Access and/or SQL query tools is a plus.

• Excellent organizational, communication, analytical and problem solving skills required.

• Ability to interact effectively with all levels of organization personnel, executive management and outside vendors,

• Must be detail oriented, focused, and have excellent analytical and problem solving skills.

• Must be customer focused – meaning must be able to understand the importance stakeholders business objectives and drive the process towards achieving those objectives.

• Strong relationship building skills and proven track record in working with all levels of an organization’s technical and business departments.

• Strong relationship building skills; must be a self-starter, enthusiastic; and possess very strong organizational, task management and prioritization skills.

• Demonstrated ability to complete deliverables on time and within budget.

• Bachelor’s degree is required.

Bachelor’s degree is required.

Join a global Contract Resource Organization (CRO) where innovation meets purpose. At **Worldwide Clinical Trials**, we're driven by a shared commitment to improving lives through high-quality clinical research. Our teams are empowered to think creatively, take ownership, and deliver meaningful work that helps bring life-changing therapies to patients around the world.

  

With more than 4,000 professionals across the globe, we foster a collaborative and inclusive environment where diverse perspectives are valued, growth is encouraged, and every contribution makes an impact. Whether you're building your career or bringing years of experience, you'll have the opportunity to learn, grow, and help shape the future of clinical research.

  

## Make an Impact as a Grants Payments Data Analyst at Worldwide

  

As a Grants Payments Data Analyst, you’ll play a key role in shaping how clinical site payments are forecasted and reported. Your work will help bring together critical financial and operational data, supporting accurate forecasting and informed decision-making across clinical studies.

In this role, you'll take ownership of forecasting models used outside of Medidata Payments, driving ongoing enhancements and ensuring alignment with broader payment forecasting processes. You’ll collaborate with teams across Revenue Recognition, Clinical Payments, Investigator Grants Payments, Project Analysis, and Clinical Operations to develop efficient, audit-ready forecasting solutions.

Your expertise will help deliver accurate client-facing financial forecasts, support compliance with financial reporting requirements, and contribute to the successful management and reconciliation of clinical site payments throughout the study lifecycle.

  

## Where You'll Work

  

This is a REMOTE role open to candidates based in India. You will collaborate with global teams across multiple time zones.

Travel for this role is remote-based and may be required only as specified by business needs.

  

## What You'll Do

  

* Develop, maintain, and continuously improve forecasting models used outside of Medidata Payments.
* Partner with Central Planning and Clinical Operations teams to gather and analyze site and patient enrollment actuals and forecasts.
* Integrate forecasting outputs with Medidata Payments forecasts to support end-to-end clinical site payment planning.
* Collaborate with Revenue Recognition teams to ensure forecasting processes meet financial audit and compliance requirements.
* Create client-ready forecasting reports and deliverables in accordance with sponsor contractual requirements.
* Analyze forecast performance, budget utilization, and plan-versus-actual results to identify trends and risks.
* Communicate over- and under-forecast variances to Project Analysts and Global Project Leads, enabling timely corrective action.
* Support study closeout activities through final payment reconciliations and preparation of client-ready financial reports.
* Contribute to process development and continuous improvement initiatives related to clinical site payment forecasting and reporting.

  

## What You'll Bring

  

* Bachelor's degree and 2–5 years of finance experience.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex financial and operational data.
* Experience working with Excel, databases, and accounting systems.
* Understanding of accounting principles and revenue recognition standards.
* Knowledge of clinical site payment processes and forecasting methodologies.
* Ability to influence, collaborate, and challenge stakeholders constructively across cross-functional teams.
* Experience supporting audit requirements, financial reporting, and compliance-related activities.
* Proficiency in English.

  

**Discover the Difference**

  

We love knowing that someone is going to have a better life because of the work we do.  Discover the Difference at Worldwide Clinical Trials. Explore additional opportunities on our careers page, visit [**http://www.worldwide.com/careers**](http://www.worldwide.com/careers)**,** or connect with us on [**LinkedIn**](https://www.linkedin.com/company/worldwide-clinical-trials-inc-/).

  
  

This is who we are.  
  
We’re a team of clinicians, scientists, and researchers who want to make healthcare better. We were founded on an unwavering commitment to authentic, personalized attention. And today, as CROs consolidate and the industry changes rapidly, that personalized attention is more important than ever.  
  
We all came to this industry for different reasons, from different walks of life. If you ask any one of us why we’re here, you’ll get a different answer. And that’s what makes us special.

Who we are

Aurora’s mission is to deliver the benefits of self-driving technology safely, quickly, and broadly.

The Aurora Driver https://aurora.tech will create a new era in mobility and logistics, one that will bring a safer, more efficient, and more accessible future to everyone.

At Aurora, you will tackle massively complex problems alongside other passionate, intelligent individuals, growing as an expert while expanding your knowledge. For the latest news from Aurora, visit aurora.tech http://aurora.tech or follow us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/auroradriver.

What we are looking for

On the Aurora Data Solutions team, you will join a world-class group whose mission is generating insights and intelligence to improve the Aurora Driver and help accelerate our path towards safe and broad commercialization of Autonomous Vehicle technology. We are looking for an exceptional Data Analyst that can play a key role in accelerating the development of the Aurora Driver by contributing towards the automation, monitoring, and analysis of our development and operational processes. This is an opportunity to leverage vast amounts of data from both online (on-road) and offline (simulation) test modalities to help Aurora achieve its product and commercialization goals.

In this role you will

- Develop reporting and analytics to optimize the value of the data we collect from our growing truck fleet

- Work closely with data scientist teammates and cross-functional Software leadership to help assess and prioritize data sourcing efforts

- Partner with Software teams to design and implement metrics and dashboards to accelerate their development processes and help them measure, understand, and improve performance

- Collaborate with the larger Data Science & Analytics community to influence Aurora’s tooling ecosystem in support of data analytics work streams

Required qualifications

- 3-4+ years of experience as a Data Analyst, Data Scientist, Data Engineer or similar technical role

- Experience taking Data Analytics projects end-to-end: synthesizing business needs, building data pipelines, adhering to high engineering rigor for safety-critical data products, and clearly communicating insights

- Able to systematically approach open-ended questions to identify pragmatic data solutions that scale

- Advanced knowledge and experience using relational databases (SQL, PostgreSQL, etc.) and familiarity with best practices for Data Engineering

- Intermediate knowledge of data analytics infrastructure, including data transformation tools such as DBT and visualization frameworks and tools

- Competent in Python, able to write readable code that others can easily interpret and build on

- Able to work effectively in a highly cross-functional, fast-moving and high-stakes environment

- Proven ability to communicate technical, data-driven analysis to both technical and non-technical audiences across stakeholders, including translating and cascading Executive input into their work

Desirable qualifications

- Advanced degree (MS) in Statistics, Computer Science, Operations Research, or a related quantitative field

- Experience with data science workflows such as classification, clustering, etc.

- Experience in the Autonomous Vehicles, Robotics, or Advanced Transportation spaces

- Experience using Amazon Web Services (AWS) tools

For roles based in Mountain View, CA and San Francisco, CA: The salary range for this position is $115,000- $184,000 per year.

For roles based in Pittsburgh, PA: The salary range for this position is $104,000 - $166,000 per year.

Aurora’s pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, the successful candidate’s starting base pay will be determined based on factors including job-related skills, experience, qualifications, relevant education or training, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future. The successful candidate will also be eligible for an annual bonus, equity compensation, and benefits.

Working at Aurora

At Aurora, we bring together extraordinarily talented and experienced people united by the strength of our values. We operate with integrity, set outrageous goals, and build a culture where we win together — all without any jerks.

We believe in-person work increases collaboration, empathy, and our ability to lead effectively. As a result, Aurorans are expected to work from the office at least 3 days per week, with some roles requiring more frequent in-office presence, up to 5 days per week, based on operational needs.

Our Careers page https://aurora.tech/careers provides insight into what it is like to work at Aurora, and you can find all the latest updates in our Newsroom https://aurora.tech/newsroom.

Our commitment to safety

At the core of everything we do is our commitment to safety. Building best-in-class self-driving technology will take time, and we believe that each employee at Aurora has a role in contributing to safety, every step of the way. Aurora expects commitment to our safety policies from every employee, and seeks candidates who take an active responsibility, can contribute to building an atmosphere of trust, and invest in the organization’s long-term success by prioritizing working safely, no matter what.

Our commitment to inclusion

Aurora considers candidates without regard to their race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy status, parent or caregiver status, ancestry, political affiliation, veteran and/or military status, physical or mental disability, or any other status protected by federal or state law. Aurora considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local law. We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at careersiteaccommodations@aurora.tech.

For California applicants, information collected and processed as part of your application and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Aurora’s California Employment Privacy Policy.
